help_text:
🐾 Welcome to the game 🐾

This Web3 gaming framework allows you to support Gery, our mountain cat.

🎯 How does it work? 🎯
1. Connect your Web3 wallet!
2. Click on the SUPPORT GERY, THE MOUNTAIN CAT button!
3. Enter the amount you wish to donate in tBNB! The minimum amount you can choose is 0.001 tBNB.
4. Click on the PAY AND START button!
5. Authorise the payment in your wallet!
6. Once the payment has been confirmed on the blockchain, you’ll be taken straight to the game menu.
7. Choose games and collect as many points as possible!

You can finish the games by clicking on ⬆ (BACK).
Click on 🏆 (LEADERBOARD) to see where you rank amongst the players.

📌 Each game carries a different weighting in the overall score. 📌

🐱 Have fun! 🐱
